column1: # Crash reports the gate tolerates in the guest, one row per kind of report:
# process is the report's file-name prefix before the timestamp (configd for
# configd_2026-10-12-101500_host.crash), matched exactly; kind is its extension
# (crash, hang, spin, diag), matched exactly. A row needs a reason someone can
# check. A kernel panic (kind panic) can never be allowlisted: health refuses
# the whole file. Starts with no rows.
